feature: Single numbered translation input with backend parsing and explicit sentence confirmation
behavior: One textarea accepts all five translations with line-leading labels 46., 47., 48., 49., and 50.; sentence-internal punctuation and wrapped lines are retained.

A session-gated backend action parses the input, rejects missing/repeated/unknown/out-of-order labels and empty or overlong answers, and returns five preview segments without storing data or calling a model.
Submission requires explicit confirmation and re-parses the raw input to verify that it still matches the preview.
Incomplete raw input can be saved as a draft. Existing five-answer records are formatted as numbered input on display without a data migration.
Sidebar collapse, original-image handling and one-current-record-per-year behavior are retained.
